summary: Swvl Holdings Corp, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release on September 1, 2026. The company announced securing its first working capital facility in the UAE with Zelo. The facility provides dedicated liquidity to fund new enterprise accounts, following approximately 5x revenue growth in the GCC since December 2024. Proceeds support client acquisition and expansion without shareholder dilution. Terms (amount, interest, maturity) are not disclosed. This is an ordinary financing arrangement, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic corporate events are present.
